Learn the key differences between addition and condensation polymerization in this Class 10 Chemistry Chapter 26 video. This tutorial is designed for Matric students following the PCTB curriculum and preparing for FBISE, Punjab Board, and other Pakistani examination boards.

In this lesson, we explain what polymerization is, how addition polymerization works through monomer linkage, and how condensation polymerization differs by releasing small molecules like water. You'll understand the mechanisms, examples (like PVC and nylon), and why these distinctions matter in organic chemistry.

Key topics covered:
• Definition and types of polymerization
• Addition polymerization process and examples
• Condensation polymerization and byproducts
• Key differences and similarities
• Real-world applications of polymers
• Important reactions for Class 10 Chemistry

This video is perfect for Matric students in Pakistan studying under the National Curriculum, whether you attend a Federal Board, Punjab Board (Lahore, Rawalpindi, Multan, Faisalabad), Sindh Board, or KPK Board school. The content aligns with PCTB textbooks and covers essential concepts tested in annual and periodic exams.

Whether you're revising Chapter 26 or learning this topic for the first time, this step-by-step explanation makes polymerization easy to understand. Don't forget to like this video, subscribe to the channel for more Class 10 Chemistry tutorials, and comment with any questions!

Double Angle and Composite Inverse Identities is a crucial topic in Class 12 Mathematics Chapter 9 for students preparing for their Intermediate exams under FBISE, Punjab Board, and all Pakistani examination boards.

In this comprehensive video, you'll learn:
• What double angle identities are and how to derive them
• Formulas for sin(2A), cos(2A), and tan(2A)
• Composite inverse trigonometric identities and their applications
• How to solve problems using these identities
• Practical examples relevant to PCTB and board exam patterns

Double angle identities are fundamental for solving complex trigonometric equations and are frequently tested in FBISE, Sindh Board, KPK Board, and other provincial examinations. These identities help simplify expressions and solve real-world problems in physics and engineering.

This lesson is designed for Class 12 (2nd Year/FSc Part 2) students following the National Curriculum of Pakistan. Whether you're preparing for your annual exams, board tests, or need extra help with trigonometry, this step-by-step tutorial covers everything you need to master this chapter.

Key concepts covered:
✓ Double angle formulas
✓ Inverse composite identities
✓ Problem-solving techniques
✓ Exam-style questions

Ethical Decision Making and Responsible Marketing is a crucial Chapter 8 topic in Class 10 Computer Science for Matric students across Pakistan. This video covers the fundamental principles of making ethical decisions in business and marketing practices that align with Pakistani values and regulations.

In this comprehensive lesson, you'll learn:

• The importance of ethical decision-making in business environments
• Core principles of responsible marketing and advertising
• How companies can balance profit with social responsibility
• Consumer protection rights and obligations
• Real-world case studies of ethical and unethical marketing practices
• The role of transparency and honesty in customer relationships
• Legal frameworks governing marketing in Pakistan

This chapter is essential for all Matric students preparing for FBISE, Punjab Board (BISE Lahore, Rawalpindi, Multan, Faisalabad, Gujranwala), Sindh Board, KPK Board, and other provincial examination boards. Whether you're using the PCTB textbook or National Curriculum materials, this video provides clear explanations of ethical decision-making frameworks that will help you score well in your exams.

Understanding ethical practices is vital not just for passing your Class 10 Computer exam, but for becoming responsible digital citizens. These concepts directly relate to your future careers in business, technology, and marketing sectors.

Watch till the end for important exam tips and summary points. If this video helped you understand ethical decision-making and responsible marketing better, please like, subscribe, and comment your questions below. Don't forget to share this with your classmates!
